gv_BLEIQuery.defaultValue:
'SELECT 
    DISTINCT BLEI.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_END_DT,

    JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI

    WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID

 AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15'
